final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(remaincount) AS avg_remain FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remain) AS overall_avg FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s.ordersmark, s.avg_remain, s.avg_remain - t.overall_avg AS difference FROM step1 AS s CROSS JOIN step2 AS t WHERE s.avg_remain > t.overall_avg), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(difference) AS avg_difference FROM step3), step5 AS (SELECT s.ordersmark, s.avg_remain, s.difference, s.avg_remain - t.avg_difference AS final_difference FROM step3 AS s CROSS JOIN step4 AS t WHERE s.avg_remain > t.avg_difference) SELECT AVG(avg_remain), AVG(difference), AVG(final_difference) FROM step5
